'''Teresa "Tere" Morató Armengol''' (born 28 March 1998) is an Andorran professional [[footballer]] who plays as a [[forward (association football)|forward]] for Spanish club Valencia and the [[Andorra women's national football team|Andorra women's national team]].

==Club career==
===ENFAF===

Morató began her club career at ENFAF Crèdit Andorrà, the only Andorran women's club, which competes in Spain. In the 2015–16 season, she scored 61 goals in 24 matches, being by far the top scorer of the Catalan Women's First Division (Spanish fourth level).<ref>{{cite web|url=http://efo87.fcf.novanet.es/pnfg/NPcd/NFG_CMP_Goleadores?cod_primaria=1000120&CodJornada=30&codcompeticion=21564286&codtemporada=11&codgrupo=21912586|title=PRIMERA DIVISIÓ FEMENÍ, GRUP 2 - Temporada 2015-2016 - Taula Golejadors|language=Catalan}}</ref> Despite her outstanding personal performance, the team finished 12th in the standings.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://efo87.fcf.novanet.es/pnfg/NPcd/NFG_VisClasificacion?cod_primaria=1000120&codjornada=30&codcompeticion=21564286&codgrupo=21912586&codjornada=30|title=PRIMERA DIVISIÓ FEMENÍ, GRUP 2 - Temporada 2015-2016 - Classificació|language=Catalan}}</ref>

===Barcelona B===

Morató's impressive performances with ENFAF meant that FC Barcelona signed her for its [[FC Barcelona Femení B|reserve team]] in the summer of 2016.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fcbarcelona.es/futbol/formativo-femenino/ficha/fc-barcelona-femeni-b-2016-/fc-barcelona-femenino-b-20162017|publisher=FC Barcelona|title=FC Barcelona – Femenino B - 2016 / 2017}}</ref>

===Rayo Vallecano===

In July 2020, Morató signed for [[Rayo Vallecano Femenino|Rayo Vallecano]] and became the first Andorran player to join the Spanish [[Primera División (women)|women's first division]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.rayovallecano.es/noticias/teresa-morato-nueva-jugadora-del-rayo-femenino|title=Teresa Morató nueva jugadora del Rayo Femenino|language=Spanish|website=Rayo Vallecano}}</ref> She made her league debut against [[Real Madrid Femenino|Real Madrid]] on 18 October 2020.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://int.soccerway.com/matches/2020/10/18/spain/superliga/real-madrid/rayo-vallecano-de-madrid/3379666/|title=Real Madrid vs Rayo Vallecano - 18 October 2020|website=int.soccerway.com}}</ref> Morató scored her first league goal against [[Athletic Club (women)|Athletic Club]] on 7 March 2021, scoring in the 60th minute.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://int.soccerway.com/matches/2021/03/07/spain/superliga/rayo-vallecano-de-madrid/athletic-club-bilbao/3379826/|title=Rayo Vallecano vs Athletic Club - 7 March 2021|website=int.soccerway.com}}</ref>

===Villarreal===

On 5 July 2021, Morató was announced at Villarreal.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://villarrealcf.es/tere-morato-talento-andorrano-para-primera-division/|title=Tere Morató, talento andorrano para Primera División|language=Spanish|website=VillarealCF|date=5 July 2021 }}</ref> She made her league debut against [[Sporting de Huelva]] on 5 September 2021.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://int.soccerway.com/matches/2021/09/05/spain/superliga/sporting-de-huelva/villarreal-cf/3576437/|title=Sporting de Huelva vs Villareal - 5 September 2021|website=int.soccerway.com}}</ref> Morató scored her first league goal against [[Real Betis Cantera|Real Betis]] on 22 December 2021, scoring in the 84th minute.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://int.soccerway.com/matches/2021/12/22/spain/superliga/real-betis-balompie/villarreal-cf/3576549/|title=Real Betis vs Villarreal - 22 December 2021|website=int.soccerway.com}}</ref>

==International career==

In 2016, she was called up to the Catalonia U18s.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.andorradifusio.ad/esports/lidil-li-amb-el-gol-de-teresa-morato|title=L'idil·li amb el gol de Teresa Morató|language=Catalan|first=Joan|last=López|website=Andorra Di Fusió}}</ref>

On 18 September 2021, she scored her first goal, which was also her first hat trick, against [[Liechtenstein women's national football team|Liechtenstein]] in a friendly match.
